notes: Inbound SMB lead. Primarily ecommerce brand (fashion + subscription boxes). Onboarded via self-serve; used free credits to prototype a chat-based order assistant. Flagged for cost spike — high token counts from verbose retrieval prompts and single-turn chat sessions. Ask: can Redwood help reduce token spend without sacrificing answer quality? Interested in batching/caching, prompt compression, and a token audit of current usage. Quoted their founder: 'We need predictable monthly spend; current tests show wild swings.' Wants simple, actionable recommendations (one-pager) and a very low-friction POC to prove savings. Security: SOC2 is a checkbox, SSO later. Prefers managed hosted API (no private infra). Tech notes: backend is Node.js, search results are pulled per-session and concatenated into prompts (heavy). Latency tolerances: p95 < 500ms for chat front-end, but they are willing to accept slightly higher latency for batching savings on non-real-time flows. Models: open to smaller quantized models + Redwood routing to cheaper variants for non-critical responses. Primary blockers: need token-visibility export and a short sample script to show batching changes. AE suggested Optimize audit and 2-week POC with $500 credits.
